name: Form Change (Ogerpon)
description: Ogerpon's form changes depending on the type of mask it wears. The four masks it can wear are the Teal Mask (Grass), Wellspring Mask (Water), Heartflame Mask (Fire), and Cornerstone Mask (Rock). Additionally, when terastallized, Ogerpon's type changes to that of its mask, regardless of its Tera Type.
